summary: Screen methane, efficiency and electrification technologies for oil and gas facilities. Explore the five-day training and plan your next step.
lede: Green technologies in oil and gas are equipment and operating changes that reduce emissions and energy use while maintaining safe production. For facility engineers, energy specialists and operations leads, the course develops practical skills to assess technology readiness, calculate methane intensity and prioritize leak detection and repair investigations. It also covers screening flare-gas recovery and electrification options using OGMP 2.0 measurement principles, ISO 50001 energy-management practices and facility constraints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for oil and gas professionals who evaluate, operate or approve facility-level technologies that can reduce emissions and energy use.
modules: Technology Readiness Levels for Oil and Gas
prerequisites: Working familiarity with oil and gas operations, facility engineering or energy management is recommended. No coding is required.
